pay_detail: Teens pay. Summer 2026 guide: $180 for members or $200 for non-members, plus a $25 registration fee per child. It does not say if the cost is per week.
notes: Only 14 and 15 year olds are in the high school range. The summer 2026 guide says ages 10 to 12, but the web pages say ages 10 to 15. Call to check. Dates shown are from last summer because 2027 dates are not posted.
name: Leaders in Training (L.I.T.)
what_you_do: A youth leadership group. It has workshops and community events that help you build leadership skills and confidence.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 ran May 25 to Aug 7, 2026. Sign-up began Feb 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted as of Nov 4, 2026.
how_to_apply: Online sign-up is paused as of Nov 4, 2026. Call the Y at (765) 474-3448 or go to the Welcome Desk.
